name: China Mobile Lijiang 5G Cloud Big Data Center Phase I
notes: Lijiang municipal media reported the Phase I project started in Jinshan subdistrict/Xintuan area; site area about 10,000 sqm, building area about 14,000 sqm, total investment about RMB 200m, planned Phase I completion and operation in 2026.

name: Phicomm Lijiang Big Data Industrial Park / Cloud Computing Data Center
developer: Shanghai Phicomm / Yunnan Construction Investment contractor
notes: 2017 sources reported a RMB 3.9-3.97bn project in Jinshan high-tech/economic zone, 283 mu, about 184,000 sqm, planned 22,000 cabinets and up to 300,000 servers; later operational status not confirmed, so status is unknown.

name: Lincang Computing Power Center
developer: Yunshang (Jiangsu) Digital Technology Co., Ltd. with Linxiang District
notes: DTDATA reported an investment/development agreement signing on 2025-12-05 in Linxiang District for a Lincang computing center intended to support AI, big data, intelligent manufacturing, smart city and cross-border digital cooperation use cases; capacity not disclosed.

name: China Unicom Yunnan Qujing Data Center and Computing Center
notes: Yunnan information-communications planning/news-conference coverage said China Unicom Yunnan planned to build three data and computing centers in Kunming, Yuxi and Qujing during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, with at least 10,000 server-hosting racks and nearly 40,000 vCPU across the three-city plan; Qujing-specific capacity not disclosed.

name: Baidu Intelligent Cloud Guangnan Digital Economy Industrial Base Phase II Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Baidu Intelligent Cloud / Guangnan County partners
notes: Yunnan Daily reported the Guangnan base in Wenshan is being built in two phases; Phase I investment about RMB 450m for labeling, metaverse and digital-human livestreaming bases, while Phase II investment about RMB 370m includes data-labeling expansion and an intelligent computing center.

name: Guangnan Yunsu Computing Power Center
developer: Jiangsu Ruiwo Group; operated by Wenshan Yunshulian Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Reported as southeast Yunnan's first county-level computing hub and Yunnan's first FP16 thousand-P intelligent computing center; planned total compute 3000P, Phase I 1000P landed/commissioned, modular container design, PUE around 1.25, privately invested and operated.

name: Yuxi Huawei and China Unicom Data Centers
developer: Huawei; China Unicom; Yuxi municipal partners
notes: Yuxi government disclosure says the city has built two Huawei and Unicom data centers with more than 1,000 cabinets; the same disclosure says a Yunnan Mobile dual-active data center project was expected to complete main works by end-2024.

name: Yuxi Compute Network Core Projects / Green Computing Cluster
developer: Yuxi municipal government and industry partners
notes: Yuxi municipal article says the city has built four data centers with compute scale above 150P, and eight compute-network core projects are accelerating; once complete they are expected to add 3000P intelligent compute with green electricity share above 85%.

name: Alibaba Cloud Zhejiang Renhe Immersion-Cooled Data Center
notes: Alibaba Cloud developer-community article reported the Zhejiang Renhe data center in Hangzhou entered operation on 2020-09-16, describing it as a large full-immersion liquid-cooled data center and China's first green grade 5A liquid-cooled data center; MW not disclosed.

name: Alibaba Cloud Linping Economic Development Zone Data Center
notes: Alibaba Cloud article says the Linping National Economic and Technological Development Zone data center was officially put into operation on 2021-06-30, Alibaba's first data center in Hangzhou's Linping District and part of its self-built Hangzhou cluster.

name: Alibaba Cloud Intelligent Group Hangzhou Linping Data Center Project Building D
developer: Alibaba Cloud Intelligent Group; built by China Construction Eighth Engineering Division
notes: Guandian reported Building D of Alibaba Cloud Intelligent Group's Hangzhou Linping data center project was completed by the contractor and moved into operating-preparation stage; project investment reported at RMB 10bn and D building area 23,400 sqm, with liquid cooling and AI-oriented general/intelligent compute.

name: China Telecom Hangzhou Big Data Center Campus
notes: Baxtel lists the campus as operational, built in 2023, spanning 168.2 mu and over 230,000 sqm, with capacity for 20,000 cabinets at 8 kW each; capacity_mw is inferred as 20,000 x 8 kW = 160 MW. Phase 1 reportedly included four data-center buildings, a power center, operations center and 110 kV substation.

name: VNET Group Hangzhou Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com listing places a VNET data center in Hangzhou Hi-Tech Zone, with high-density rack capability up to 10 kW per cabinet, dual-grid 2N electrical input, N+1 diesel backup, precision air/water cooling and Tier III+/Tier IV-grade redundancy claims; exact MW not disclosed.
